<a id="body"></a>

## Body

- A head is final only when none of my messages that could move it are still unread by the coder. Check my outbound queue before sending a head to the verdict seats.
- Busy seats read messages only at turn end (F25). Don't send hold chasers; request verdicts once, on the final head, with a fresh detached worktree per head.
- Fold optional notes into the round's checklist up front, or into a follow-up plan (209), never mid-verdict.
- Security is the bottleneck. A second holder (pij-alert-ibex) is allowed; rebalance by queue length.
- Prime exceptions: tests that time real child processes may run nice-only; builds always run under nice -n 19 taskpolicy -b.
